name: App windows
summary: The VM's programs open as windows on the Mac, each a window of its own: no display needed. Builds Monad's window manager in the VM, and adds a terminal (foot) to start with.

steps.title: A C compiler and a terminal
Monad's window manager
steps.script:
# The VM's programs as windows on the Mac: Monad's own window manager, built
# here from the sources Monad's installer puts in a Linux VM, with the VM's C
# compiler (Monad ships no program for Linux it did not build). It takes no
# display: the windows' pixels go to the Mac over Monad's own channel, so it
# runs beside the Desktop profile's session too. What programs started from a
# tab need to find it (/etc/profile.d/monad-windows.sh) comes from Monad's
# installer too.
lib="$MONAD_ROOT/usr/local/lib/monad"
# The installer runs at each boot, about when this does: it may still be at it.
n=0
while [ ! -e "$lib/wm-build" ] && [ "$n" -lt "${MONAD_WM_WAIT:-60}" ]; do
    sleep 1
    n=$((n + 1))
done
if [ ! -e "$lib/wm-build" ]; then
    echo "Monad has put no window manager in this VM yet. It does when the VM starts: restart it, and set this profile up again." >&2
    exit 69
fi
sh "$lib/wm-build" "$lib" || exit $?
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable monad-wm.service
systemctl restart monad-wm.service
